verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay documents JWT-based authentication. A production user describes handing clients a distinct "publish credential" only after a subscriber is attached, which implies credentials can be limited to the publish role. Scoping, path or broadcast restrictions, issuance tooling and least-privilege semantics are not documented first-party. missing for 10: first-party docs on token scopes/claims (publish vs subscribe, path/broadcast restrictions), credential issuance/revocation tooling, expiry controls, agent-oriented guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Encrypted via TLS and authenticated via JWT.
The relay holds that subscription open, and only then is the client given a publish credential.
